subject: Request for post-report bridge letter and evidence handbook
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumenforge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, procurement@lumenforge.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: post-report bridge letter + evidence handbook

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well — I’m Jordan on LumenForge procurement. We’re wrapping up our vendor security review and need a short bridge letter confirming Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage for the period after your last report (report period end: 2025-12-31) up to the current date.

Specifically, the security & compliance team has asked for:
- A signed bridge letter stating there are no material changes to controls since 2025-12-31 (or a clear list of any exceptions/remediations).
- A copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF).
- An evidence index summarizing supporting artifacts we can review (change management, IAM, encryption/KMS, incident history, vulnerability/pen test summary).
- Dates for when the evidence pack can be made available and how (secure drive link or portal).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the bridge letter and evidence pack this week? If you prefer, we can accept a preliminary bridge letter and then a follow-up evidence bundle.

Thanks — please CC anyone at Redwood who should own the evidence handover.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Procurement Manager
LumenForge
[Attachment: RFQ-LumenForge-20260901.pdf (PDF)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumenforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-report bridge letter + evidence handbook

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the RFQ. We can support this request. High-level plan below:

1) Bridge letter: we will draft a short letter confirming control continuity since 2025-12-31 and call out any open remediation items if applicable. We use a standard template (attaching).
2) SOC 2 report: attaching the latest PDF.
3) Evidence index: we will produce an index CSV listing the artifacts (logs, configs, policies) and provide a secure Share Drive link for downloading.

Proposed timeline:
- Today/EOD: send SOC 2 PDF + bridge letter template and a preliminary evidence index (redacted where necessary).
- Within 48 hrs: finalized signed bridge letter (DocuSign) and full evidence pack access.

Notes: For sensitive items (KMS rotation logs, audit logs) we will provide scoped extracts and an index rather than raw dumps. If you need anything in a specific format (SFTP, secure Share), let us know.

I've CC'd Marissa (legal/compliance lead) and Karthik (security ops) who will coordinate the evidence handover.

Regards,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: bridge-letter-template.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumenforge.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-report bridge letter + evidence handbook

Jordan — quick note from legal/compliance: we can sign the bridge letter but standard practice is to include a sentence limiting the assertion to the period following the attached report and to identify any open remediation items. If there are no exceptions, we will state that explicitly.

Camila — please route the final draft to legal for review; we typically need up to one business day for standard wording. Also confirm whether the pen test summary and incident timeline can be sent as redacted PDFs (that is our usual approach).

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumenforge.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-report bridge letter + evidence handbook

Jordan — attaching the evidence index CSV that maps the requested control areas to the artifacts we will provide. Highlights:
- Change management: PR history + release cadence summary (redacted).
- IAM: SSO configuration export + user access review snapshot (redacted IDs).
- Encryption/KMS: key rotation schedule and KMS policy excerpt.
- Incident history: summary log of incidents since 2026-01-01 with remediation status.
- Penetration test: summary report (redacted) and remediation closure list.

We will host the full package on a secure Share (link below) with time-limited access. Expect the DocuSign request for the bridge letter by end of day tomorrow.

[Attachment: evidence-index.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
[Secure link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-evidence-pack]

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@lumenforge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-report bridge letter + evidence handbook

Camila — team, appreciate the quick turnaround. We received the SOC 2 PDF and the evidence index; the Share link works. A couple quick clarifications before our security review: 

- Please confirm whether there have been any exceptions or remediation items opened since 2025-12-31 (if yes, a short list is sufficient).
- Confirm that redacted pen test summary includes date of last test and whether high/critical findings remain open.

We've scheduled our internal review for Monday and would like the signed bridge letter (DocuSign) by EOD Monday if possible — we will escalate internally if needed. I’ll watch for the DocuSign link.

Thanks again — Jordan
Procurement Manager | LumenForge
[DocuSign: https://docusign.com/requests/ABCD-1234-efgh]
